disposition.note: "AFTER FLOAT": same glyphs, drawn 1.74pt lower than Word (glyph top 231.48pt against 229.75pt), exactly as on main before this change. The empty anchor paragraph's line is taller than Word's, whose paragraph mark is painted in the Aptos the package's missing styles part leaves as default. Word also pair-kerns 'A'-'T' by 1.64pt in this package without a styles part, although the run states no w:kern, so its final 'T' is at 148.93pt against our 150.36pt. Both residuals are below materiality; recorded under #1874.
